content.text: Perfect! Let me create one final verification to ensure everything is correct:

input.command: cd /mnt/user-data/outputs && echo "=== FINAL VERIFICATION ===" && echo && echo "✓ Files created:" && ls -1 *.{tsv,json,py,md,txt} 2>/dev/null | nl && echo && echo "✓ File sizes:" && du -h *.{tsv,json,py,md,txt} 2>/dev/null && echo && echo "✓ Standardized TSV rows:" && wc -l met_inventory_standardized.tsv && echo && echo "✓ SHA-256 verification:" && sha256sum met_inventory_standardized.tsv
